messages:
Eli Navarro (AE): Quick escalate 9— AstraNova Therapeutics asking for a 2-month migration pilot with a deep credit. They want a $75k credit applied to invoices while they move models. Can we approve? Link: https://gd.doc/astranova-pilot
Nora Patel (Finance): Need the ask spelled out: monthly token estimate, whether they're prepaying, and what downstream commitment looks like. 75k sounds high for a short pilot.
Eli Navarro (AE): They estimate ~3M tokens total over 60 days. Customer willing to prepay $25k but expects $75k applied (net free). They argue it's strategic (healthcare ref).
Hector Ruiz (RevOps): Standard practice: 1) cap one-time credits to match prepayment or approved cap, 2) require signed SOW/addendum, 3) enforce token cap with automatic throttling, 4) label billing item clearly. My proposal: cap credit at $30k, token cap 3,500,000, any overage billed at list. Recommend pilot term = 60 days, credit applied as "Pilot Credit - AstraNova".
Zoe Park (Legal): We can draft an addendum. Must include audit rights, DPA alignment, and a clause to void credits if customer misreports usage or violates DPA. Suggest adding: "Credits contingent on Customer delivering weekly usage exports and cooperating with audit requests; misuse or breach voids remaining credits."
deal-bot: Automated check 9— requested credit $75,000 exceeds standard SDR limit of $10,000. Escalation to Finance + Legal required. Case: deal-3034567890.
Nora Patel (Finance): Finance position: Approve up to $30k one-time credit only if: 1) Prepayment or PO for $25k received before pilot start, 2) Signed addendum and SOW, 3) Token cap enforcement at 3.5M tokens with auto-throttle, 4) Weekly usage reporting, 5) Credits expire 30 days after pilot. If they insist on $75k we need Director-level approval.
Eli Navarro (AE): Customer prefers not to prepay but can provide PO. They pushed back on 30k cap and asked for at least $50k. Can we route to Director?
Hector Ruiz (RevOps): If Director approval needed, include a clear billing automation: ```billing_item: Pilot Credit - AstraNova; amount: $30,000; type: credit; enforcement: token_cap=3_500_000; overage_rate=list``` I'll prepare the billing ticket once Finance confirms amount.
Zoe Park (Legal): Legal sign-off provided for the $30k structure and addendum language. Adding indemnity carveouts for misuse during migration is recommended.
Nora Patel (Finance): Final from Finance at 3034567955: Approve one-time pilot credit up to $30,000 (matching RevOps cap) subject to: PO or prepayment of $25k, signed SOW/addendum with audit & DPA clauses, token cap enforcement, weekly usage reports, and credits expire 30 days post-term. Director escalation required for any credit > $30k. Nora Patel (Finance) 3034567955
